title: Clean Netherrack
description: A simple pack that makes the Texture of Netherrack jsut one color.
body:
# Clean Netherrack

A minimal resource pack that replaces the default Netherrack texture with a clean, single-colored version. No noise, no cracks, no clutter — just a flat, solid color that makes the Nether easier on the eyes and simpler to build with.

## Features
- Fully flat, single-color Netherrack texture (`#652828`)
- No other blocks or textures are touched — this pack only affects Netherrack
- Lightweight and simple: perfect for builders who want a cleaner, more uniform Nether aesthetic

## Compatibility
- Built for Minecraft Java Edition **26.2** (Chaos Cubed)
- Pack format: `83`

## Installation
1. Download the `.zip` file
2. Drop it directly into your `resourcepacks` folder (no need to extract)
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** in-game

## Notes
This pack is intentionally minimal — if you're looking for a full texture overhaul, this isn't it. It's meant for people who just want Netherrack without the visual noise.
